st: Halfway through, how are this year's 2022 predictions doing?

sec.p: Apparently, there are fully digital influencers. That alone is a trend nobody saw coming. To fight the perfection of social media (which is limitless when control over the character is total, given its digital nature), Jesse Zhang created Angie, a virtual influencer with…

Even if the endless scroll of social media feels free, besides paying for it with our data, it also has an impact on energy emissions. To remind us of this, an Amsterdam design studio redesigned the Volkswagen website to make it more sustainable.

sec.t: ff.26.3 The superfoods that will save the planet
sec.p: Rice, by the way, is eco-friendly. Wheat, which yields only once a year and constantly needs replanting, slightly less so. A recently proposed alternative is Kernza (Thinopyrum intermedium). Unlike wheat, this special-K is perennial and produces seeds cyclically.
